_readme: Optional cosmetic per-genus knobs. Both control how far a tall stack of
labels may ride above the timeline, so they matter only where many
species share one year. Omit a genus entirely and it takes the defaults
(top 18, labelFloor -9) -- the values the live Alocasia spec uses.
amorphophallus is recorded here because its live spec differs.
These are the ONLY hand-set numbers in the whole pipeline.
